public class Div2_421C {

	public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
		Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
		int a = scanner.nextInt();
		int b = scanner.nextInt();
		long l = scanner.nextLong();
		long r = scanner.nextLong();

		if (r - l + 1 >= 2 * (a + b)) {
			if (a <= b) {
				System.out.println(a + 1);
			} else {
				System.out.println(2 * a - b);
			}
			return;
		}

		char[] cArray = new char[a];
		for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
			cArray[i] = (char) ('a' + i);
		}

		l--;
		r--;

		Arrays.fill(cArray, 'a', a, 'a');

		int ans = 26;
		for (int first = 0; first < 26; first++) {
			for (int second = a; second < 26; second++) {
				for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
					cArray = Arrays.copyOf(cArray, cArray.length + 1);
					cArray[cArray.length - 1] = (char)('a' + first);
				}
				Arrays.fill(cArray, a, cArray.length, 'a');
				Arrays.sort(cArray, a, cArray.length);
				int nxt = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
					while (Arrays.binarySearch(cArray, a, cArray.length, (char) ('a' + nxt)) >= 0) {
						nxt++;
					}
					cArray = Arrays.copyOf(cArray, cArray.length + 1);
					cArray[cArray.length - 1] = (char) ('a' + nxt);
					nxt++;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
					cArray = Arrays.copyOf(cArray, cArray.length + 1);
					cArray[cArray.length - 1] = (char)('a' + second);
				}

				int len = cArray.length;

				Arrays.sort(cArray);
				Arrays.fill(cArray, (int) (l % len), (int) ((r + 1) % len), 'a');
				int count = 0;
				for (int i = (int) (l % len); i != (r + 1) % len; i = (i + 1) % len) {
					if (cArray[i] != 'a') {
						count++;
					}
				}
				if(count < ans){
					ans = count;
				}
				Arrays.fill(cArray, 0, len, 'a');
			}
		}

		System.out.println(ans);
	}
